subject: Step5 OOM is not explained by simple token load
body: Read-only tokenizer diagnostic against the exact frozen train rows: step1 rows0-7 = 2742 total tokens, max479, mean342.8 and passed; step2=1972/max386; step3=1510/max304; step4=1885/max449; failed step5 rows32-39 = 2220 total, max480, mean277.5; step6 rows40-47 would be 2086/max482. Therefore step5 is not materially larger than the already-passed fresh step1 and token volume alone does not explain the OOM. This strengthens accumulated continuous-state / allocator-fragmentation / external-memory-pressure hypotheses, while causal attribution remains unestablished.
